test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 15 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/704095ab81467c7fe91778073eaf5bf1132e608d019a5716179b56ddada7289e.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Each letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -3, +5.

Let's check each option:

1. MT – JZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5eec326e74928bea6af69ca34c34d621ed896117c5b9d06b960603272218bdcf.png] 

This letter-cluster pair does not follow the pattern -3, +5.

2. SV – PA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f45e9fa5d305a068309468dc48188dadaa24d1b921ef2fad3238e551104a111.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -3, +5.

3. RD – OI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07905d08bcca1c4cb3cb0365f75205c8cb4f03e29cded7f1ac99d0b0e9519e03.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -3, +5.

4. KQ – HV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc949f7d2436a6999b0dff270771db5bdb5f3ad8754dd23897064fb45be0a2ff.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -3, +5.

Thus, MT – JZ is the odd one out.

 

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 1**".
